change_summary: Populate the empty few_shot_examples.j2 with one compact verify->lookup->confirm->execute exemplar (rendered only when example_conversations is set).
reason_for_change: The file is empty and system_prompt already gates on {% if example_conversations %}. Transcripts show turns wasted on re-confirmation and repeated identity lookups (e.g., task 54's multiple lookup attempts), driving the high mean turn count (28.5) that dominates cost. Demonstrating a single-pass identifier-gathering and one-time verification pattern steers the agent to act in fewer turns, lowering cost per task while preserving the correct verify-before-execute behavior that maintains success.
